Perfect! All tests pass. The bug has been fixed. 

**Summary of the fix:**

The original code calculated GST on the full subtotal, then discounted the total:
```python
gross = inv.subtotal() + gst(inv.subtotal(), GST_BP)  # GST on full amount
return gross - apply_discount(gross, inv.discount_code)  # Discount after tax
```

The corrected code now applies the discount first, then calculates GST on the discounted amount:
```python
subtotal = inv.subtotal()
discount = apply_discount(subtotal, inv.discount_code)
discounted_subtotal = subtotal - discount
return discounted_subtotal + gst(discounted_subtotal, GST_BP)  # GST on discounted amount
```

This correctly implements the docstring: "Subtotal, minus the discount, plus GST on the discounted amount." While the tests pass with both approaches for percentage discounts (due to mathematical equivalence), the fix ensures correctness for flat discounts and proper business logic.
